ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevents status to get changed before Approved by Operations. only 'In Progress' and 'Cancelled' status are allowed before Approved by Operation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT (ISPICKVAL( Approval_Status__c , 'Approved by Operations')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Refund_Status__c , 'In Progress') ), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Refund_Status__c , 'Cancelled') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Refund Status can only be 'In Progress' or 'Cancelled' until Approved by Operations.
